biotools.summary: MicroBundleCompute is a computational framework for automated segmentation, tracking, and analysis of subdomain deformation in cardiac microbundles. The tool offers tools for tissue segmentation and tracking, enabling the quantification of morphology-based mechanical metrics from beating cardiac microbundles.
